title: Data Engineer Salary Canada 2026: Pay, Skills and Visas
metaDescription: Complete guide to data engineer salaries in Canada in 2026: pay by experience, top cities, in-demand tools, work permits and tips for negotiating a strong
headline: Data Engineer in Canada: Salaries and Careers in 2026

sections.title: The Canadian Data Job Market
sections.content:
Canada's data engineering market continues to expand as banks, insurers, retailers, telecom companies and startups modernise their data platforms and adopt cloud analytics. Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal and Calgary host the largest concentrations of data roles, with remote-friendly employers increasingly hiring across provinces.

Employers look for engineers who can design reliable pipelines, model data for analytics, and keep systems running at scale, rather than candidates who only know one tool. Experience with cloud platforms and a track record of shipping production pipelines are the strongest signals in hiring.

sections.title: Salaries by Experience Level
sections.content:
Junior data engineers in Canada typically earn between eighty thousand and one hundred and five thousand Canadian dollars per year, depending on city, company size and sector. Mid-level engineers with three to five years of experience usually earn between one hundred and ten thousand and one hundred and forty-five thousand dollars.

Senior and staff data engineers can earn between one hundred and fifty thousand and one hundred and ninety-five thousand dollars, with higher totals at large technology companies and financial institutions. Annual bonuses, stock options and restricted stock units can add a meaningful share on top of base salary.

sections.title: Skills and Tools Employers Want
sections.content:
The most requested skills include SQL, Python, Apache Spark, dbt, Airflow, Kafka, Snowflake, BigQuery and Databricks, along with strong data modelling and data quality practices. Cloud experience on AWS, Azure or GCP is now close to essential, since most new platforms are built on managed cloud services.

Employers also value experience with data governance, privacy, observability and cost optimisation, since unreliable or expensive pipelines quickly become a business problem. A portfolio showing end-to-end projects, from ingestion to a dashboard or machine learning feature, carries more weight than a list of certificates.

sections.title: Work Permits and Negotiating an Offer
sections.content:
Foreign data engineers commonly arrive through Express Entry, often with employer support, or through the Global Talent Stream, which speeds up work permits for in-demand technology occupations. Provincial nominee programs also offer dedicated technology streams for candidates with skills needed locally.

Toronto and Vancouver have the highest salaries but also the highest rents, while Montreal and Calgary offer a lower cost of living. Before accepting an offer, compare base salary, bonuses, equity, vacation, health coverage and remote-work flexibility, rather than judging the offer on base salary alone.

faqs.q: What is the average data engineer salary in Canada in 2026?
faqs.a: Junior data engineers typically earn between eighty thousand and one hundred and five thousand Canadian dollars per year, while mid-level engineers earn between one hundred and ten thousand and one hundred and forty-five thousand dollars. Senior engineers can reach one hundred and ninety-five thousand dollars at large technology companies and financial institutions.

faqs.q: Which data engineering tools are most in demand in Canada?
faqs.a: The most requested tools include SQL, Python, Apache Spark, dbt, Airflow, Kafka, Snowflake, BigQuery and Databricks, along with cloud experience on AWS, Azure or GCP. Strong data modelling, data quality practices and pipeline observability are equally important, since employers want systems that stay reliable at scale.

faqs.q: Which Canadian cities pay data engineers the most?
faqs.a: Toronto and Vancouver generally offer the highest salaries, reflecting their large technology and financial sectors, but they also have the highest rents. Montreal and Calgary often combine solid salaries with a lower cost of living, making total compensation and lifestyle worth comparing city by city.

faqs.q: What work permit routes exist for foreign data engineers?
faqs.a: Foreign data engineers commonly arrive through Express Entry, often with employer support, or through the Global Talent Stream, which speeds up work permits for in-demand technology roles. Provincial nominee programs also offer dedicated technology streams for candidates with skills that local employers need urgently.
